services.desc: Captain Spencer has designed his Charter Pricing to be competitive and provide more value with no hidden charges. All prices are visible on this website and documented for public viewing. Captain Spencer’s Fishing Charters are fixed-priced for 2 people. There is an additional fee for each person over the 2 passengers. The maximum number of passengers per boat is 4 adults and potentially 2 children. For the Gulf Sunset Charter (a non-fishing charter), the pricing is per boat, and there is no cost for passengers. You can purchase optional merchandise on board, such as hats, sunglasses, tee-shirts, insulated cooler fish bags, etc. Please note: Captain Spencer’s prices are completely listed

quotes.author: Michael Kenas
quotes.text: Captain Spencer was excellent for our family outing. He knew all the prime fishing spots and the right methods in the bay. At our request we took a break on a small island to look for shells and let the kids play. Kids (7&9) had a blast and caught lots of large fish of severs species. Recommend for a great time inshore.

quotes.author: Erin N. Carter
quotes.text: Captain Spencer was amazing! Great communication, knowledgeable of the area, listened to what our three boys wanted to do and found spots for them to fish for the things they were interested in… fantastic experience. Highly recommend!!!

quotes.author: kevin eells
quotes.text: I've been out with Capt. Spencer a few times, and he has never let down. The boat is always in good shape. He shows up at the agreed upon meeting spot promptly and has never failed to get me onto some fish!

quotes.author: Mackenzie Riordan
quotes.text: Highly recommend Captain Spencer! He is extremely knowledgeable on the local fish and we always have a good time on the boat!

quotes.author: Karyn Froio
quotes.text: Captain Spencer was great. We caught fish the entire time. We will definitely fish with him again in the future.

quotes.author: BRILLIANT brill
quotes.text: We had an amazing time! Very knowledgeable and accommodating, we will be back again! 🎣
